mission: Create a real, sellable digital product and reach the first 250 CZK of owner-verified net revenue.

missions.title: Bootstrap: build the first product and launch assets
missions.measurable_target: Product zip builds with 0 failing automated checks; landing page, marketing drafts, dashboard and tests exist.

missions.title: Verify the kit in Roblox Studio and capture real previews
missions.measurable_target: 14/14 steps of docs/STUDIO_TEST_CHECKLIST.md pass; >= 4 real screenshots or 1 short GIF.

missions.title: Publish a paid listing (owner action)
missions.measurable_target: 1 public listing with a working paid checkout and the zip attached.

missions.title: Launch distribution in legitimate channels
missions.measurable_target: >= 3 posts in channels whose rules allow it, and >= 100 listing page views within 14 days (store analytics).

missions.title: Conversion review and listing fix (read-only agent + owner)
missions.measurable_target: 1 concrete listing change shipped; view-to-purchase rate measured before and after over 7 days each.

missions.title: Free 'Lite' lead magnet linking to the full kit
missions.measurable_target: Lite version published for free; >= 1 owner-verified sale of the full kit within 21 days.

external_services.payments: NOT INTEGRATED - owner sells via a store account they create; sales are entered manually
external_services.publishing: NOT AUTOMATED - owner posts drafts from marketing/ by hand
external_services.roblox_studio: NOT AVAILABLE in build environment - Studio test is mission M001
